summary: A Yes vote adopts a City of Benicia business license tax that sets rates by business category, exempts businesses with $100,000 or less in annual receipts, and applies a separate marine terminal rate.

tax.text: A Yes vote would adopt the restructured business license tax, generating additional city revenue.
tax.quote: Measure X is a business license tax.

tax.text: A No vote would leave the existing business license tax system in place.
